author: Hamer, J. and others
title: Search for $B^0 \to \pi^- \tau^+ \nu_\tau$ with Hadronic Tagging at Belle
abstract: We search for the process $B^0 \to \pi^- \tau^+ \nu_\tau$ using the full Belle data set of $711\,\mathrm{fb}^{-1}$, corresponding to $772 \times 10^6 B\bar{B}$ pairs. We observe an excess of $2.8\sigma$ ($2.4\sigma$ including systematic uncertainties) above the background-only hypothesis. An upper limit of $\mathcal{B}(B^0 \to \pi^- \tau^+ \nu_\tau) < 2.5 \times 10^{-4}$ is obtained at the 90% confidence level.
